items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: Some of the fellas who started out with Sidney and Desveen, they still play with Houston... I wanted to stop playing music. He didn't want me to stop.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. He's a good trumpet man too. I haven't seen him in a long time. Work with Joey Williams? I haven't seen him lately. Hmm? I haven't seen him lately either. I know.
Yeah, Sidney, stop playing music. He's running a cab line.
Well, Joe Phillips now, does he still have a band?
